final_structured_result.brief: Accelerating tilt on adjacent NODE_03 and NODE_02 with rising micro-seismic emissions and 89-min threshold projection indicates true progressive subsidence. Keep critical alert, evacuate and restrict area above NODE_02/03, deploy survey team to inspect for cracks and accelerate monitoring.
findings: NODE_03 tilt rose monotonically 1.21 to 6.29 deg over 60min (slope 0.075/min), peak at 12:00Z with no return to baseline.
Spatially concentrated on 2 adjacent nodes: NODE_03 6.11 and NODE_02 5.84 deg change vs NODE_01 0.099 / NODE_04 0.124, correlation 0.9543.
OLS trend highly significant: slope 0.097/min, R2 0.9595, t-stat 26.2, projecting to 15.0 threshold in 89.3 min.
Piezo acoustic emission rising 0.021 to 0.108 with positive slope, sensor healthy (all flags ok), vibration normal baseline ~0.09.
